architecture_decisions.recommendation: Added @wxt-dev/is-background as a dependency to the analytics package to leverage existing background detection logic
architecture_decisions.rationale: The analytics package previously had a TODO comment indicating the need for a more generic background script detector. Instead of reimplementing this logic, we're reusing the existing is-background package that's already part of the wxt monorepo. This follows the DRY principle and ensures consistent background detection across all wxt packages.
alternatives_considered: Implementing custom background detection logic directly in the analytics package
Creating a new shared utility package for background detection
Keeping the existing path-based detection but improving it

architecture_decisions.recommendation: Replaced location.pathname check with isBackground() function call for cleaner, more maintainable background detection
architecture_decisions.rationale: The previous implementation relied on checking if location.pathname === '/background.js', which was noted as only working for standard WXT extensions. The new approach uses a dedicated function that encapsulates the detection logic, making it more readable and allowing the detection algorithm to evolve independently of the analytics package.
alternatives_considered: Keeping the path-based check but adding more conditions for different browsers
Creating a configuration option for users to manually specify background context
Using feature detection of browser extension APIs instead of path checking

architecture_decisions.recommendation: Reorganized package.json fields to group related properties together (scripts, dependencies, devDependencies)
architecture_decisions.rationale: The package.json was restructured to follow a more logical grouping: scripts first (as they're commonly referenced), then dependencies, then repository metadata. This improves readability and maintainability by keeping related configuration sections together.
alternatives_considered: Using a different grouping strategy (alphabetical, by frequency of use)
Moving all configuration to a separate config file

tickets.title: Replace custom background detection with shared is-background utility
tickets.description: Updated the analytics client to use the existing @wxt-dev/is-background package for detecting background script context instead of the fragile path-based check

tickets.title: Update package dependencies and lockfile
tickets.description: Added @wxt-dev/is-background as a dependency and updated pnpm-lock.yaml to reflect the new workspace dependency

implementation_summary:
The implementation addresses the need for enhanced background script detection in the analytics package by leveraging an existing utility package within the wxt monorepo. Instead of maintaining custom detection logic that was limited to 'standard WXT extensions' (as noted in the TODO comment), the solution imports and uses the @wxt-dev/is-background package, which presumably contains more robust detection logic that works across different browsers and extension frameworks.

This approach demonstrates good software engineering practices by promoting code reuse and separation of concerns. The is-background package can evolve its detection algorithm independently, potentially handling edge cases across Chrome, Firefox, and Edge browsers, while the analytics package simply consumes this functionality through a clean API. The change also improves code readability by replacing a magic string comparison with a semantically named function call.

The package.json reorganization, while not directly related to the feature request, shows attention to code quality and maintainability. By grouping related configuration sections together, the file becomes easier to navigate and understand. The lockfile update ensures that the new dependency is properly tracked in the monorepo's dependency management system, maintaining consistency across the project.
